event_context.status: NASA-documented pre/during observation dates; flood onset not fixed here
event_context.note: NASA compares January 5 and January 17. Flooding developed over a longer rainfall interval: January 5 is the comparison image, not proven entirely pre-flood. January 17 is a during-flood acquisition; Beta calibration caveats apply. This is a wider geographic context crop; it does not establish the complete flood extent.

limitations: Backscatter differences are observations, not verified disaster extent
Shared display clipping is for visualization, not threshold selection
